# sdwan_sig_security_sig_feature (Resource)

This resource can manage a SIG Security SIG Feature.
  - Minimum SD-WAN Manager version: `20.15.0`

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sdwan_sig_security_sig_feature" "example" {
  name               = "Example"
  description        = "My Example"
  feature_profile_id = "f6dd22c8-0b4f-496c-9a0b-6813d1f8b8ac"
  sig_provider       = "Generic"
  interfaces = [
    {
      interface_name          = "gre1"
      auto                    = false
      interface_description   = "Tunnel to SIG data center A"
      unnumbered              = true
      tunnel_source_interface = "GigabitEthernet1"
      tunnel_route_via        = "GigabitEthernet1"
      tunnel_destination      = "198.51.100.10"
      tunnel_set              = "secure-internet-gateway-other"
      tunnel_dc_preference    = "primary-dc"
      tcp_mss_adjust          = 1300
      mtu                     = 1400
      tracker                 = "tracker1"
      track_enable            = true
    }
  ]
  interface_pairs = [
    {
      active_interface        = "gre1"
      active_interface_weight = 255
      backup_interface        = "None"
      backup_interface_weight = 1
    }
  ]
  tracker_source_ip = "192.0.2.10"
  trackers = [
    {
      name             = "tracker1"
      endpoint_api_url = "http://gateway.example.com/vpntest"
      threshold        = 1000
      interval         = 30
      multiplier       = 2
    }
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `feature_profile_id` (String) Feature Profile ID
- `interfaces` (Attributes List) Interface name: IPsec when present (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))
- `name` (String) The name of the Feature
- `sig_provider` (String) SIG Provider
  - Choices: `Umbrella`, `Zscaler`, `Generic`

### Optional

- `aup_enabled` (Boolean) Enable Acceptable User Policy
  - Default value: `false`
- `aup_timeout` (Number) Custom Acceptable User Policy frequency in days, Attribute conditional on `aup_enabled` equal to `true`
  - Default value: `0`
- `auth_required` (Boolean) Enforce Authentication
  - Default value: `false`
- `block_internet_until_accepted` (Boolean) For first-time Acceptable User Policy behavior, block Internet access, Attribute conditional on `aup_enabled` equal to `true`
  - Default value: `false`
- `caution_enabled` (Boolean) Enable Caution
  - Default value: `false`
- `description` (String) The description of the Feature
- `display_time_unit` (String) Display time unit, Attribute conditional on `surrogate_ip` equal to `true`
  - Choices: `MINUTE`, `HOUR`, `DAY`
  - Default value: `MINUTE`
- `force_ssl_inspection` (Boolean) For first-time Acceptable User Policy behavior, force SSL inspection, Attribute conditional on `aup_enabled` equal to `true`
  - Default value: `false`
- `idle_time` (Number) Idle time to disassociation, Attribute conditional on `surrogate_ip` equal to `true`
  - Default value: `0`
- `interface_pairs` (Attributes List) Interface Pair for active and backup (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interface_pairs))
- `ip_enforced_for_known_browsers` (Boolean) Enforce Surrogate IP for known browsers
  - Default value: `false`
- `ips_control` (Boolean) Enable IPS Control
  - Default value: `false`
- `location_name` (String) Zscaler location name (optional)
  - Default value: `Auto`
- `location_name_variable` (String) Variable name
- `ofw_enabled` (Boolean) Firewall enabled
  - Default value: `false`
- `primary_data_center` (String) Custom Primary Datacenter
  - Default value: `Auto`
- `primary_data_center_variable` (String) Variable name
- `refresh_time` (Number) Refresh time for re-validation of surrogacy in minutes
  - Default value: `0`
- `refresh_time_unit` (String) Refresh Time unit
  - Choices: `MINUTE`, `HOUR`, `DAY`
  - Default value: `MINUTE`
- `secondary_data_center` (String) Custom Secondary Datacenter
  - Default value: `Auto`
- `secondary_data_center_variable` (String) Variable name
- `src_vpn` (Boolean) Share Source VPN
  - Default value: `false`
- `surrogate_ip` (Boolean) Enable Surrogate IP, Attribute conditional on `auth_required` equal to `true`
  - Default value: `false`
- `tracker_source_ip` (String) Source IP address for Tracker
- `tracker_source_ip_variable` (String) Variable name
- `trackers` (Attributes List) Tracker configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--trackers))
- `umbrella_primary_data_center` (String) Umbrella Primary Datacenter
  - Default value: `Auto`
- `umbrella_primary_data_center_variable` (String) Variable name
- `umbrella_secondary_data_center` (String) Umbrella Secondary Datacenter
  - Default value: `Auto`
- `umbrella_secondary_data_center_variable` (String) Variable name
- `xff_forward_enabled` (Boolean) XFF forwarding enabled
  - Default value: `false`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the Feature
- `version` (Number) The version of the Feature

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Expected import identifier with the format: "sig_security_sig_feature_id,feature_profile_id"
terraform import sdwan_sig_security_sig_feature.example "f6b2c44c-693c-4763-b010-895aa3d236bd,f6dd22c8-0b4f-496c-9a0b-6813d1f8b8ac"
```
